g1.label: 1. Where was the phone found?
g1.why: The recording says the phone was found near the changing rooms.

g2.label: 2. What is on the phone case?
g2.why: The recording says the phone case has an orange flower sticker on the back.

g3.label: 3. What time was it handed in?
g3.why: The recording says the phone was handed in just after eleven o'clock.

g4.label: 4. What must the owner do?
g4.why: The recording says the owner must be ready to describe the lock screen and colour.

g5.label: 5. What happens to uncollected phones?
g5.why: The recording says phones not collected by Friday will be handed to the local police.

g6.label: 6. What is Sam's problem?
g6.why: The recording says Sam lost his phone that morning.

g7.label: 7. What must Sam describe?
g7.why: The recording says Sam must describe the lock screen, which is a photo of his dog.

g8.label: 8. What does Leah joke about?
g8.why: The recording says Leah jokes about Sam not forgetting his bag again.

g5.why: The text says lost property is kept for two weeks, not one month.

g6.why: The text confirms students must show their student ID card to collect an item.
